# POPPET-CLASS OUTLAW SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Small
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 1-3
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Solar + Biofuel
# Shuttle Brief
A ship once designed for cleaning up messes, now repurposed for making them.
# Ship Functions
The Poppet ditches most of its janitorial trappings for a small cargo bay and hidden gun port.
Note that the solar array does not produce sufficient power for continuous thruster operation. Use the thruster power toggle button on the bridge to disable thrusters when docked if attempting to operate without consuming biofuel.
# Button Configuration
The ship console has buttons mapped:
[bullet/] [bold]1:[/bold] Turn thrusters+gyro on.
[bullet/] [bold]2:[/bold] Turn thrusters+gyro off.
[bullet/] [bold]3:[/bold] Toggle bridge windows.
[bullet/] [bold]4:[/bold] Gun deck inner window/door bolt toggle.
[bullet/] [bold]5:[/bold] Open gun port doors.
[bullet/] [bold]6:[/bold] Fire cannon (with door safety check).
[bullet/] [bold]7:[/bold] Close gun port doors.
[bullet/] [bold]8:[/bold] Fire cannon (override door safety check).
